title: Saw a 10+ year Big 4 IT Auditor say AI is automating core testing and shrinking contracts. How accurate is this from the Cyber/GRC side?
content_md:
Saw a post over on r/ITAudit recently from a Big 4 vet with 10+ years in the field, and it raised some interesting points about where the domain is heading. His main argument wasn't just the usual complaint about burnout or long hours. He claimed IT Audit is going through a real structural shift because of AI and client budget cuts: Contract prices are getting squeezed: Clients are renegotiating fees down, so Big 4 teams are being forced to stack way more engagements per person just to hit revenue targets. Core testing is being automated: The bulk of entry-to-mid level work (testing ITGCs, SOC 1/2 controls, documenting evidence) is easily handled by AI now.
